name: Quaternary
description: Ice ages, the rise of Homo sapiens and late megafaunal extinctions.
descriptionZh: 冰期循环、智人兴起与晚期巨型动物灭绝。

name: Neogene
keyContinentalConfig: Continents near modern positions; the Isthmus of Panama forms
description: Grasslands spread, hominins diversify and land bridges reshape dispersal.
descriptionZh: 草原扩张、人族多样化，陆桥重塑生物扩散。

name: Paleogene
keyContinentalConfig: India collides with Asia and the Atlantic widens
description: Mammals radiate after the K–Pg boundary and early primates diversify.
descriptionZh: K–Pg 界线后哺乳动物辐射，早期灵长类多样化。

name: Cretaceous
keyContinentalConfig: Continents disperse and the South Atlantic opens
description: Flowering plants diversify; the interval ends at the K–Pg boundary.
descriptionZh: 被子植物多样化；该时段止于 K–Pg 界线。

name: Jurassic
keyContinentalConfig: Pangaea breaks apart and the Central Atlantic opens
description: Birds originate while dinosaurs and marine reptiles diversify.
descriptionZh: 鸟类起源，恐龙与海生爬行动物多样化。

name: Triassic
description: Early dinosaurs and mammals appear before the end-Triassic crisis.
descriptionZh: 早期恐龙与哺乳动物在三叠纪末危机前出现。

name: Permian
description: Synapsid-rich ecosystems precede the end-Permian mass extinction.
descriptionZh: 合弓类丰富的生态系统出现在二叠纪末大灭绝之前。

name: Carboniferous
keyContinentalConfig: Pangaea assembles amid extensive tropical wetlands
description: Coal-forming forests expand and early amniotes diversify.
descriptionZh: 成煤森林扩张，早期羊膜动物多样化。

name: Devonian
description: Jawed fishes, forests and early tetrapods transform ecosystems.
descriptionZh: 有颌鱼类、森林与早期四足动物重塑生态系统。

name: Silurian
keyContinentalConfig: Continents converge during the Caledonian orogeny
description: Vascular land plants appear and jawed fishes diversify.
descriptionZh: 陆生维管植物出现，有颌鱼类多样化。

name: Ordovician
keyContinentalConfig: Gondwana lies near the south pole
description: Marine biodiversity expands before the end-Ordovician crisis.
descriptionZh: 海洋生物多样性在奥陶纪末危机前扩张。

name: Cambrian
description: Animal body plans and mineralized skeletons diversify in the fossil record.
descriptionZh: 动物身体构型与矿化骨骼在寒武纪化石记录中多样化。
